name: OIDC (GitHub Actions) role trust with a tight subject (repo + ref) -> does NOT fire the high expansion finding (boundary)
note: IAM-804 boundary: a Federated OIDC sub bound to a specific repository AND ref (repo:example-org/repo-name:ref:refs/heads/main) scopes trust to one workload. TRUST-FEDERATED is still emitted (a federated relationship exists) but at low/medium - it must NOT reach HIGH, distinguishing a properly-scoped workload from an org-wide wildcard. The aud check is recognized as a constraint. Target-role permissions remain out of scope / unknown.
